name: berlin-daily-0230-hour-that-does-not-exist
description: The reading that does not exist: 02:30 on the night Berlin springs forward. The occurrence moves forward by the gap - it is answered as 03:30 local, the same instant 02:30 would have named had the hour existed - and the series returns to 02:30 the next day. This is the standard library's rule rather than this adapter's, pinned here so that a change to it is visible in a diff.
